situation.whoThisIs: Grom Digital, a UK marketing agency selling done-for-you patient acquisition to aesthetic and cosmetic clinics. Founder-led sales calls.
situation.howLeadsArrive: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lead-form ads. The lead never visits a website first, so the email address is pre-filled from their Facebook profile and is often a secondary or dormant inbox.
situation.whatIsSold: The Pilot Program: free for 30 days, the client pays on results. A signed client is TRIALING before any money moves, and there is no upfront fee to object to.
situation.theFunnel: enquiry -> conversation -> booked Clinic Growth Strategy Session with a founder -> attended -> signed agreement -> 30-day trial -> paying
situation.objective: Engagement, booking, attendance AND conversion, judged on money earned. In the owner's words: we want people to be engaged, but not only engage, convert as well.
knownDataCaveats: This pipeline marks an opportunity `won` ONLY once the client PAYS. There is no stage for closed-and-trialing, so signed clients sit in `open` indefinitely. A zero win count NEVER means nothing closed, and `showed_to_decision` reading zero is the same artefact.

The 11 KPIs from `won_to_internal_handoff` onward describe the client DELIVERY journey, which happens in a separate onboarding portal and not in this system. They read UNKNOWN forever on this evidence and are not findings.
Nothing records the moment a lead becomes qualified, so `contacted_to_qualified` and `qualified_to_strategy_call` have no signal at all.

This system is DESIGNED to handle leads with automation and AI, and its AI books more appointments than any other route. Inserting a human is not a generic fix here and must be argued from the evidence if argued at all.

The Voice AI agent named VOKI, business name Voksica, is a TEST agent and is not part of this business. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28. Its script, its Make.com webhook actions and its physiotherapy framing are all deliberate scratch work, so none of that is a finding. What WOULD be a finding is VOKI having inbound calling switched on, or a workflow or calendar routing real contacts to it: check isInboundActive before dismissing anything about it.

PLANNED, NOT BUILT: the onboarding AI assistant in the client portal (Hana) is intended to send clients a DAILY onboarding update. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28. So the delivery-side comms gap this account shows is being addressed outside this system, and a recommendation to add more GHL email chases to the onboarding ladders is probably the wrong fix. What IS still a fair finding on the delivery side: a chase that threatens a sanction nothing carries out, a ladder with no ending, copy that contradicts the sales promise, and anything a daily update would not fix.

targets.basis: This system contacts every enquiry by automation, so anything short of near-total coverage is a delivery or enrolment failure rather than a sales result. Speed matters more than coverage here: published data puts close rates at 32% when the first reply lands inside five minutes against 12% at 24 hours, and the average business takes 42 hours.

Normal band for a FREE B2B discovery call is 50 to 70 percent, and 65 is the middle of it. Owner chose normal deliberately on 2026-07-28. The same research puts a paid or deposit-backed call at 85 percent, so raising this target is a product decision about charging for the call, not a marketing one.

About 35 percent of shown high-ticket B2B discovery calls close, and first-meeting-to-opportunity runs 30 to 50 percent where discovery is sharp. Read this against the caveat that this pipeline only marks won once the client PAYS.
